            --accent-glow: rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.15);
            --accent-secondary: #e8963a;
            --accent-secondary-glow: rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.15);
            --accent-red: #ff4d6a;
            --accent-green: #00e676;
            --border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            --border-accent: rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.2);

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Syne', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2.8vw, 2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 0.95rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.8rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.2rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
            --duration-slow: 1s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        :root {
            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.125rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        h1, h2, h3, h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BACKGROUND EFFECTS
           =========================================== */
        .bg-grid {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
        }

        .bg-gradient-mesh {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.03) 0%, transparent 70%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.75s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.2); }
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
        }

        @keyframes dash-flow {
            to { stroke-dashoffset: -20; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-secondary));
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            z-index: 9998;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 12px);
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-primary);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.07) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .title-slide .accent-line {
            width: clamp(40px, 8vw, 120px);
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
            margin: 0 auto clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .title-slide h1 .accent {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
        }

        .title-slide .subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.15rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: min(85vw, 700px);
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .title-slide .source-ref {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .title-slide .source-ref a {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        /* Decorative corner brackets */
        .corner-decor {
            position: absolute;
            width: clamp(30px, 5vw, 60px);
            height: clamp(30px, 5vw, 60px);
            border-color: rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.15);
            border-style: solid;
            border-width: 0;
        }
        .corner-decor.tl { top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); left: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-top-width: 2px; border-left-width: 2px; }
        .corner-decor.tr { top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-top-width: 2px; border-right-width: 2px; }
        .corner-decor.bl { bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); left: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-left-width: 2px; }
        .corner-decor.br { bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-right-width: 2px; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM
           =========================================== */
        .problem-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
        }

        .problem-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .problem-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .problem-card.static::before {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-red), transparent);
        }

        .problem-card.evolving::before {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
        }

        .problem-card .card-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .problem-card.static .card-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .problem-card.evolving .card-label { color: var(--accent-primary); }

        .problem-card .card-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .problem-card ul {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .problem-card li {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
            padding-left: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem);
        }

        .problem-card li::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0.5em;
            width: 5px;
            height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .problem-card.static li::before { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .problem-card.evolving li::before { background: var(--accent-primary); }

        .problem-callout {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--accent-glow);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-primary);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) 0;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM
           =========================================== */
        .architecture-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .loop-diagram {
            position: relative;
            width: min(90vw, 850px);
            height: min(55vh, 420px);
        }

        .loop-stage {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-circle {
            width: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            height: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border: 2px solid;
            position: relative;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            opacity: 0.6;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-desc {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: clamp(90px, 12vw, 140px);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            line-height: 1.35;
        }

        /* Stage positions — rectangular loop */
        .stage-evidence {
            top: 5%;
            left: 5%;
        }
        .stage-evidence .stage-circle {
            border-color: var(--accent-primary);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1);
        }

        .stage-attribution {
            top: 5%;
            right: 5%;
        }
        .stage-attribution .stage-circle {
            border-color: #6c8cff;
            background: rgba(108, 140, 255, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(108, 140, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .stage-evolution {
            bottom: 5%;
            right: 5%;
        }
        .stage-evolution .stage-circle {
            border-color: var(--accent-secondary);
            background: rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.1);
        }

        .stage-distribution {
            bottom: 5%;
            left: 5%;
        }
        .stage-distribution .stage-circle {
            border-color: #b388ff;
            background: rgba(179, 136, 255, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(179, 136, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* SVG Arrows between stages */
        .loop-arrows {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            width: 100%; height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .loop-arrows svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .loop-arrows .arrow-path {
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2;
            stroke-dasharray: 8 4;
            animation: dash-flow 1.5s linear infinite;
        }

        /* Center label */
        .loop-center-label {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .loop-center-label .center-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-primary);
        }

        .loop-center-label .center-sub {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        /* Input/Output labels */
        .loop-io {
            position: absolute;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .loop-io.input-label {
            top: 50%;
            left: 0%;
            transform: translate(-100%, -50%);
        }

        .loop-io.output-label {
            top: 50%;
            right: 0%;
            transform: translate(100%, -50%);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: AGENTIC EVOLVER PIPELINE
           =========================================== */
        .pipeline-stages {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .pipeline-stage {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pipeline-stage::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .pipeline-stage.stage-1::before { background: var(--accent-primary); }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-2::before { background: #6c8cff; }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-3::before { background: var(--accent-secondary); }

        .pipeline-stage .stage-step {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .pipeline-stage .stage-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1.15rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .pipeline-stage.stage-1 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-primary); }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-2 .stage-title { color: #6c8cff; }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-3 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-secondary); }

        .pipeline-stage .stage-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .pipeline-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .evolver-callout {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.08);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-secondary);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) 0;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: MULTI-USER AGGREGATION
           =========================================== */
        .aggregation-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
        }

        .user-signals {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .user-signal {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
        }

        .user-signal .signal-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .user-signal .signal-dot.success { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .user-signal .signal-dot.failure { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .user-signal .signal-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .aggregation-insight {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

                    <div class="tk-body">Skill evolution is driven by runtime interaction without manual curation or explicit user intervention. No human in the loop needed.</div>

       JAVASCRIPT: PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       ========================================= -->
    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;

                    if (e.deltaY > 30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    else if (e.deltaY < -30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
                }
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        .architecture-container {

    <!-- Progress bar -->
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 1: TITLE

    <section class="slide title-slide bg-grid">

        <p class="subtitle reveal">Enabling LLM agent skills to continuously evolve by aggregating cross-user interaction trajectories and applying agentic, evidence-driven skill updates</p>

                <p class="heading-sub">Users rediscover solutions independently — knowledge never accumulates at the system level</p>

                    <div class="card-label">Current Paradigm</div>

                        <li>Skills manually installed from a centralized hub</li>

                        <li>Same failure patterns recur across users over time</li>
                        <li>Memory-based methods stay tied to specific instances</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>

    <section class="slide bg-gradient-mesh bg-grid">

                    <div class="stage-title">Evidence</div>

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;

                    if (e.deltaY > 30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    else if (e.deltaY < -30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
                }
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>

            color: var(--text-secondary);

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;

                    if (e.deltaY > 30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    else if (e.deltaY < -30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
                }
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        h1, h2, h3, h4 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BACKGROUND EFFECTS
           =========================================== */
        .bg-grid {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
        }

        .bg-gradient-mesh {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.03) 0%, transparent 70%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.75s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.2); }
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
        }

        @keyframes dash-flow {
            to { stroke-dashoffset: -20; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-secondary));
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            z-index: 9998;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 12px);
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-primary);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.07) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .title-slide .accent-line {
            width: clamp(40px, 8vw, 120px);
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
            margin: 0 auto clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .title-slide h1 .accent {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
        }

        .title-slide .subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.15rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: min(85vw, 700px);
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .title-slide .source-ref {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .title-slide .source-ref a {
            color: var(--accent-primary);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        /* Decorative corner brackets */
        .corner-decor {
            position: absolute;
            width: clamp(30px, 5vw, 60px);
            height: clamp(30px, 5vw, 60px);
            border-color: rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.15);
            border-style: solid;
            border-width: 0;
        }
        .corner-decor.tl { top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); left: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-top-width: 2px; border-left-width: 2px; }
        .corner-decor.tr { top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-top-width: 2px; border-right-width: 2px; }
        .corner-decor.bl { bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); left: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-left-width: 2px; }
        .corner-decor.br { bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-right-width: 2px; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM
           =========================================== */
        .problem-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
        }

        .problem-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .problem-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .problem-card.static::before {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-red), transparent);
        }

        .problem-card.evolving::before {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
        }

        .problem-card .card-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .problem-card.static .card-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .problem-card.evolving .card-label { color: var(--accent-primary); }

        .problem-card .card-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .problem-card ul {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .problem-card li {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
            padding-left: clamp(0.8rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem);
        }

        .problem-card li::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0.5em;
            width: 5px;
            height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .problem-card.static li::before { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .problem-card.evolving li::before { background: var(--accent-primary); }

        .problem-callout {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--accent-glow);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-primary);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) 0;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM
           =========================================== */
        .architecture-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .loop-diagram {
            position: relative;
            width: min(90vw, 850px);
            height: min(55vh, 420px);
        }

        .loop-stage {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-circle {
            width: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            height: clamp(70px, 10vw, 110px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border: 2px solid;
            position: relative;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            opacity: 0.6;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .loop-stage .stage-desc {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: clamp(90px, 12vw, 140px);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            line-height: 1.35;
        }

        /* Stage positions — rectangular loop */
        .stage-evidence {
            top: 5%;
            left: 5%;
        }
        .stage-evidence .stage-circle {
            border-color: var(--accent-primary);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1);
        }

        .stage-attribution {
            top: 5%;
            right: 5%;
        }
        .stage-attribution .stage-circle {
            border-color: #6c8cff;
            background: rgba(108, 140, 255, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(108, 140, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .stage-evolution {
            bottom: 5%;
            right: 5%;
        }
        .stage-evolution .stage-circle {
            border-color: var(--accent-secondary);
            background: rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.1);
        }

        .stage-distribution {
            bottom: 5%;
            left: 5%;
        }
        .stage-distribution .stage-circle {
            border-color: #b388ff;
            background: rgba(179, 136, 255, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(179, 136, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* SVG Arrows between stages */
        .loop-arrows {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            width: 100%; height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .loop-arrows svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .loop-arrows .arrow-path {
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2;
            stroke-dasharray: 8 4;
            animation: dash-flow 1.5s linear infinite;
        }

        /* Center label */
        .loop-center-label {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .loop-center-label .center-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-primary);
        }

        .loop-center-label .center-sub {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        /* Input/Output labels */
        .loop-io {
            position: absolute;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .loop-io.input-label {
            top: 50%;
            left: 0%;
            transform: translate(-100%, -50%);
        }

        .loop-io.output-label {
            top: 50%;
            right: 0%;
            transform: translate(100%, -50%);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: AGENTIC EVOLVER PIPELINE
           =========================================== */
        .pipeline-stages {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .pipeline-stage {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pipeline-stage::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .pipeline-stage.stage-1::before { background: var(--accent-primary); }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-2::before { background: #6c8cff; }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-3::before { background: var(--accent-secondary); }

        .pipeline-stage .stage-step {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .pipeline-stage .stage-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1.15rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .pipeline-stage.stage-1 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-primary); }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-2 .stage-title { color: #6c8cff; }
        .pipeline-stage.stage-3 .stage-title { color: var(--accent-secondary); }

        .pipeline-stage .stage-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .pipeline-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .evolver-callout {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: rgba(232, 150, 58, 0.08);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-secondary);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) 0;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: MULTI-USER AGGREGATION
           =========================================== */
        .aggregation-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: start;
        }

        .user-signals {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .user-signal {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
        }

        .user-signal .signal-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .user-signal .signal-dot.success { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .user-signal .signal-dot.failure { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .user-signal .signal-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .aggregation-insight {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .aggregation-insight .insight-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .aggregation-insight .insight-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .system-pills {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .system-pill {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px) clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 20px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDES 6 & 7: CASE STUDY TABLES
           =========================================== */
        .case-study-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: baseline;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .case-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            padding: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px) clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .case-badge.accept-low {
            background: rgba(255, 77, 106, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 77, 106, 0.2);
        }

        .case-badge.accept-high {
            background: rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.2);
        }

        .evolution-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 0;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .evolution-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: left;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .evolution-table tbody td {
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .evolution-table tbody tr:last-child td {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .evolution-table .day-cell {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .evolution-table .candidate-cell {
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: clamp(120px, 20vw, 220px);
        }

        .evolution-table .rationale-cell {
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            max-width: clamp(150px, 25vw, 280px);
        }

        .validator-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: 2px clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .validator-badge.accept {

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;

                    if (e.deltaY > 30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    else if (e.deltaY < -30) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

                const navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
                }
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
